declaration.preface: OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD, incorporated on February 10, 2006, is dedicated to designing and manufacturing hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic steering systems for off-highway vehicles, automotive, and marine applications. We are committed to environmental stewardship, ensuring that our operations and products contribute positively to sustainability. We are committed to sustainable practices that minimize our environmental impact and promote the well-being of our customers and the community. This policy outlines our approach to environmental management of operations and products, focusing on key sustainability issues such as energy consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, water usage, air pollution, materials, chemicals, waste, product use, and product end-of-life.
declaration.declaration: Ognibene India Pvt Ltd. is dedicated to minimizing our environmental impact through effective management of operations and products. This includes reducing energy consumption and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, responsible water management, minimizing air pollution, managing materials and waste, and advocating for sustainable practices among our customers.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD, (OIL). It covers all business activities, including procurement, sales, marketing, and any interactions with government officials, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The policy is applicable globally, regardless of local business practices or cultural norms. This policy applies to below mentioned locations:

Energy Optimization & GHG Mitigation: We are committed to reducing overall energy consumption and minimizing GHG emissions across all operations by improving energy efficiency and integrating sustainable practices. By optimizing machinery, LED lighting, and digital energy monitoring we reduce overall energy consumption by 25% by 2030, using 2023 as the baseline year, and achieve a 20% reduction in Scope 1, Scope 2 and scope 3 GHG emissions by 2030.
Renewable energy: We are committed to increasing renewable energy usage to strengthen the sustainability of our operations. By expanding solar rooftop installations and procuring certified green electricity we achieve 35% renewable energy share of total consumption by 2030.
Water Stewardship: We are committed to the responsible management of water resources to protect local water supplies and reduce pollution by Lowering the water consumption by 10% by 2030 compared to the baseline year 2023 levels, and decrease water pollution incidents by 50% by 2030. Effluent treatment and monitoring will maintain 100% compliance and zero discharge violations by 2030. By implementing rainwater harvesting we reduce water consumption by 10% by 2030
Air Quality Improvement: We aim to improve local air quality by minimizing emissions of non-GHG air pollutants, targeting a 25% reduction in emissions of SOx, NOx, VOC, and PM by 2030, while also limiting instances of non-compliance with air quality regulations to less than 2% of total operations.
Waste Minimization & Management: We are committed to minimizing waste generation and enhancing our waste management practices by promoting recycling and responsible disposal. By implementing zero-waste initiatives, improved segregation, and vendor take-back programs we reduce total waste generation by 40% by 2030 and increase recycling of non-hazardous waste to 65% by 2030. By monitoring waste streams and training employees we ensure efficient waste handling and compliance by 2030.
Sustainable Product Lifecycle Management: We are committed to designing products that are environmentally sustainable throughout their lifecycle, from production to disposal. By designing modular and recyclable products and implementing take-back programs we ensure 85% of products are sustainable by 2030 and reduce emissions and disposal impacts by 45% by 2030. By evaluating product materials and end-of-life solutions we continuously enhance product sustainability by 2030.
Product Use Efficiency: We are committed to enhancing the energy efficiency and environmental performance of our products during their use phase. By optimizing hydraulic system designs and integrating smart flow control components we improve product energy efficiency by 30% by 2030. By conducting performance testing and operational monitoring we ensure products operate at peak efficiency and minimize environmental impact by 2030.
Environmental Outreach & Customer Engage: We are committed to promoting sustainable practices among our customers through outreach and education by launching at least two sustainability awareness programs annually and achieve a 40% participation rate among customers in these initiatives by 2030.
Ecosystem Conservation: We are dedicated to conserving local ecosystems and biodiversity by conducting biodiversity assessments and implement measures to mitigate impacts on local habitats, aiming for a 50% reduction in negative impacts by 2030. The company targets 27% vegetation coverage by 2030, including 2,000 native tree plantations and conservation of local species around Pune and Punjab facilities
Responsible Sourcing Practices: We are committed to sourcing materials responsibly by ensuring suppliers adhere to defined sustainability criteria. By conducting supplier audits, sustainability assessments, and providing guidance on ESG improvements we ensure 100% of suppliers meet sustainability standards by 2030. By integrating supplier engagement and monitoring programs we strengthen sustainable procurement by 2030.
Employee Participation in Sustainability: We are committed to fostering a culture of environmental responsibility within our workforce by providing environmental training to 100% of employees by 2030 and encourage their participation in sustainability initiatives.
Customer Health & Safety: We are committed to ensuring our products are safe and environmentally responsible for customer use. By performing rigorous product safety testing, using environmentally safe materials, and implementing operational controls we maintain 100% compliance with customer health and safety regulations by 2030. By monitoring product performance and integrating eco-conscious practices we minimize environmental impacts during product use by 2030.
Regulatory Compliance & Continuous Enhan: We are dedicated to adhering to all applicable environmental regulations and continuously improving our practices and achieve 100% compliance with environmental regulations by 2030 and conduct annual internal audits to identify areas for improvement.

responsibilities.duty: The responsibility for implementing and monitoring this policy falls to the Environmental Compliance and the Safety Officer.
The Safety Officer ensures compliance with health and safety standards related to environmental practices.
The Environmental Manager oversees adherence to environmental regulations and the overall sustainability strategy.
All employees are encouraged to actively contribute to these initiatives.

policy.reviewMechanism: The review of this policy will be conducted every two years by the Environmental Compliance Officer. This process will assess the effectiveness and relevance of the policy, incorporating feedback from employees and stakeholders to enhance our environmental practices.
